name: graphin-guide
description: Usage guidance for the graphin MCP server: skills for progressive-disclosure navigation (search → explore → read) and for the docs/wiki knowledge layer — knowledge sets over documentation sections, a project glossary, the propose-and-review queue, and the pre-flight gate that blocks delegation or edits until the knowledge for the work has been loaded. Plus two subagents: a read-only, budget-aware navigator that answers both where-it-lives and how-it-behaves questions, moving between the symbol, keyword, semantic and graph retrievers as each response directs; and a wiki maintainer that repairs dangling, drifted and unread knowledge sets through a judged write tool and leaves every change marked for a person to review. Install alongside the graphin plugin.
